summary: Build 18 — Account deletion + support routing PREVIEW verification. Backend (pytest against preview FastAPI mirror /api): 7/7 PASS in 1.58s. Verified POST /api/v1/account/delete parity with production TS backend: (a) no Bearer -> 401, (b) missing/incorrect confirm -> 400, (c) wrong password -> 403 'Password is incorrect.', (d) correct password + confirm=DELETE with fresh registered account -> 200 {deleted:true}, (e) subsequent GET /api/v1/account with old token -> 401 (session revoked), (f) login with deleted credentials -> 401 (account NOT auto-recreated), (g) reusing revoked token for second delete -> 401. Plus support ticket regression: POST /api/v1/support/tickets -> 200 with VP- ticketId. Frontend E2E on preview URL (375x667): registered fresh account b18.ui.1785440579@vaultpop.test / UiDeleteTest!234, sign-in state established, account-delete-link visible on /account. Tapped it -> /delete-account renders warning card ('What will be removed'), Apple subscription card with delete-account-manage-subscriptions button, delete-account-password-input, delete-account-confirm-input, delete-account-confirm-button. Confirm button was aria-disabled=true initially and became enabled (aria-disabled=null) once password AND confirmText=DELETE were filled. Wrong password + DELETE -> 403 from mirror -> 'Password is incorrect.' status pill shown, account NOT deleted. Correct password + DELETE -> success screen 'All Done / Your account has been permanently deleted' rendered; delete-account-done-button tapped -> navigated to home (/). Post-delete /account showed the signed-out registration/sign-in view (delete-link gone, no crash, no loops). Re-signing in with the deleted credentials returned a friendly 401 error in the UI, confirming no auto-recreation. Regression smoke: /legal shows Privacy Policy + Terms of Use, /support ticket form submits successfully (Ticket VP-000010 submitted), home screen loads with 0 console errors. React Native deprecation warnings emitted (props.pointerEvents, textShadow*, useNativeDriver) are pre-existing framework/lib warnings — see react_native_issues.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted on /account and post-delete home. Likely from a third-party RN component (react-native-svg or similar) — not from Build 18 delta. Reference: browser console during /account load.

Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"' during navigation transitions. Not introduced by delete-account screen. Reference: browser console after delete success -> /.
Warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' — expected on web preview; harmless. Reference: pre-existing across all routes.

action_items: No fixes required for Build 18 account deletion / support routing delta — all acceptance checks pass on preview mirror + preview frontend.

(Optional, not blocking Build 18) The three React Native deprecation warnings above are pre-existing library-level noise; consider addressing on a future maintenance pass once RN web upgrades stabilize.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py L312-339 POST /api/v1/account/delete: correct 401/400/403/200 branches, revokes ALL sessions for the account (not just current token), cascades deletion of password resets and, if linked, support tickets / ad events / leaderboard scores keyed by installId. No target parameter — horizontal deletion impossible by construction. Matches production TS backend contract described in /app/memory/test_credentials.md Build 18 section.

frontend/src/screens/delete-account-screen.tsx: canDelete gate (password.length>0 && confirmText.trim()==='DELETE' && !busy) enforces the disabled-until-valid rule; verified via aria-disabled in browser. On success, createDefaultSaveProfile() replaces the entire local profile — clean local wipe. SessionExpiredError branch also clears the session properly.

frontend/src/screens/account-screen.tsx L232-238: account-delete-link ActionLink to /delete-account with accent=ruby and correct testID. Signed-out branch has no delete link, matching the not-signed-in delete-screen fallback.

frontend/src/account/account-service.ts L189-209 deleteAccountPermanently: sends {password, confirm:'DELETE'} + Bearer token; maps 401 to SessionExpiredError and other non-ok to friendly Error; explicitly requires body.deleted===true before resolving. Clean.
